title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Balance Tests for Premier Money Market and Money Market Account on an Upgrade
content:
When an owner asks for a Savings & Money Market Accounts product to be moved up to the highest money market tier they qualify for, the two money market tiers below Private Client Money Market are judged on balance alone. This page gives those balance tests.

## Rule

- **Premier Money Market** qualifies when the account's comparison balance is at least **10000.00** US dollars.
- **Money Market Account** qualifies when the account's comparison balance is at least **2500.00** US dollars.

Neither tier asks for any Personal Checking relationship in this test.

## Quick reference

| Comparison balance (hypothetical) | Premier Money Market qualifies | Money Market Account qualifies |
|---|---|---|
| 12000.00 | yes | yes |
| 10000.00 | yes, exactly at the level | yes |
| 9999.99 | no | yes |
| 2500.00 | no | yes, exactly at the level |
| 2499.99 | no | no |

## Points of judgement

**Is "at least" inclusive?** Yes. A balance equal to the figure qualifies.

**Can a balance qualify for both tiers at once?** Yes. Any balance that meets the Premier Money Market figure also meets the Money Market Account figure; which of them becomes the target is a question of ranking, not of these tests.
